about: Homebrew games - engine reimplementations and source ports.
NO COMMERCIAL TITLES ARE LISTED HERE AND NONE WILL BE. A list of urls for commercial
games is a list of pirated games. Every entry below is an open-source engine published
MOST OF THEM NEED DATA FILES FROM A COPY YOU OWN. The engine is free; Doom's WAD and
Diablo's MPQ are not, and are not distributed here. An entry that needs data says so in
its description - a game that installs cleanly and then refuses to start is the worst
version of this to debug, because nothing failed.
The split between this file and packages.json is THIS PROJECT'S, not upstream's: they are one
release and one kind of artifact. Things you run to do something are in packages.json;
things you run to play are in titles.json. Nothing depends on the split being right.
PROVENANCE. Every entry is an asset of the ps5-payload-dev/websrv release v0.34,
published 2026-08-02. The digests are the ones GitHub states for those assets, and two
of them were checked here by downloading the file and hashing it - the API and the bytes
agreed, which is why the rest are trusted without pulling a gigabyte to prove it.
These install under /data/homebrew, which was measured on a target rather than guessed.
The format is docs/manifest.schema.json - the same one payloads use. Nothing about
fetching or verifying cares what kind of thing it is moving.

payloads.name: CrispyDoom
payloads.description: Doom source port. Needs a Doom WAD you already own - installs without one and will not start.
